name: Global temperature
summary: Global temperature 1.99°C above pre-industrial on 1 Nov, a record for the date
state: ERA5 data for 1 Nov put global surface air temperature about 1.99°C above pre-industrial levels, a record for the calendar date and well past the 1.6°C Alert line (Climate Reanalyzer). The strong El Niño, with an Oceanic Niño Index of +2.5, is adding to long-term warming (NOAA CPC).
for_you: Record warmth raises the odds of heatwaves, heavy rain and drought; follow national met service warnings.

sources.title: Climate Reanalyzer — Daily surface air temperature (ERA5)

why: Global temperature is the master climate variable; each tenth of a degree raises extreme-weather risk.
drivers: Greenhouse gases, El Niño/La Niña, aerosols, solar cycle.

rubric.alert: > +1.6°C, or a record high for the calendar date.
rubric.normal: Daily global anomaly < +1.3°C above pre-industrial (ERA5 vs 1991–2020 + 0.88°C).
